Name: Formal limit definition/Formell gränsvärdedefinition
Basic relationship:
lim{x->a, f(x)} = L
For any \e > 0, there exist \d > 0 such that |x-a|<\d => |f(x)-L|<\e

lim{x->\inf, f(x)} = L
For any \e > 0, there exist R > 0 such that x>R => |f(x)-L|<\e

Left limits (Vänstergränsvärde), Right limits (Högergränsvärde)

Name: Limit value in infinity/Gränsvärde i oändligheten
Basic relationship: lim{x->\inf, f(x)}=L means that f(x) approaches L for any large x

Name: Infinite limit value/oändliga gränsvärde
Basic relationship: lim{x->a, f(x)}=\inf means f(x) greater than any number by choosing x sufficiently close to a, (Improper limit/Oegentlig gränsvärde)

Name: Informal limit definition/Informell gränsvärdedefinition
Basic relationship:
lim{x->a, f(x)} = L
f(x) does not have to be defined at x=a
When limit x approaches a, f(x) approaches L

Name: Determinable forms
Basic relationship:
(A+\inf=\inf, A*\inf=\inf, \inf+\inf=\inf, \inf*\inf=\inf, \inf^\inf=\inf, ln(\inf)=\inf, A/\inf=0, \inf/A=\inf, A/(0+)=\inf, A/(0-)=-\inf)

lim{x->a, f(x)} = f(a)

Name: Forced fractional/radical simplification (lim->\inf)
Basic relationship: Order of growth: 1 < ln(x) < x < x*ln(x) < x^2 < x^3 < ... < 2^x < 3^x < ...

Name: Difference to fraction
Basic relationship:
(Exceptions to logarithms and other difference bindings), (lim{x->a, A(x)} = \inf, lim{x->a, B(x)} = \inf)
lim{x->a, A(x)-B(x)} = lim{x->a, (A(x)-B(x))(A(x)+B(x))/(A(x)+B(x))} = lim{x->a, (A^2(x)-B^2(x))/(A(x)+B(x))}

Name: Substitution to growth order
Logarithmic limits

Basic relationship: lim{x->\inf, ln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]x^k})/ln(+{k=0, len(B)-1, B[k]x^k})} = lim{x->\inf, (ln(x^(len(A)-1)) + ln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]x^(k-len(A))}))/(ln(B[len(B)-1]) + ln(+{k=0, len(B)-1, B[k]x^(k-len(B))}))}

Name: Trigonometric oscillation
Presetted values:
lim{x->\inf, sin(x)/x^2}=0, lim{x->\inf, cos(x)/ln(x)}=0
lim{x->\inf, cos(x)/ln(x)} undefined

Name: Inverse trigonometric arithmetic
Basic relationship:
lim{x->1-, arccos(x)/sqrt(1-x)} = [t=arccos(x)] = lim{t->0-, t/sqrt(1-cos(t))} = lim{t->0-, t/sqrt(2sin^2(t/2))}
lim{x->0, arctan(Ax)/(Bx)} = [t=arctan(Ax)] = lim{t->0, At/B*tan(t)} = A/B

Name: Completion using forlong
Presetted values:
lim{x->0, sin(x)/sin(3x)} = lim{x->0, (sin(x)/x)/(sin(3x)/x)
lim{x->\inf, (x+cos(3x))/(2x+sin(x))} = lim{x->\inf, x(1+cos(3x)/x)/(x(2+sin(x)/x))
lim{x->0, (e^(3x)-1)/(e^(4x)-1)} = lim{x->0, ((e^(3x)-1)/x)/((e^(4x)-1)/x)
lim{x->0, xln(sin(x))} = lim{x->0, x(ln(x)+ln(sin(x)/x))}

Name: Exponential form
Basic relationship:
lim{x->0+, A(x)} = \inf, lim{x->0+, B(x)} = \inf
lim{x->0+, A(x)^B(x)} = lim{x->0, e^B(x)ln(A(x))}

Name: Squeeze theorem
Basic relationship: g(x) <= f(x) <= h(x), a in [A, B] -> lim{x->a} g(a)=h(a) -> lim{x->a, f(x)}=lim{x->a, g(x)}=lim{x->a, h(x)}

Name: Continous function/Kontinuerligt
Basic relationship: f(x) continous in a, if lim{x->a, f(x)=f(a)
Informal definitions: Coherent (sammanhängande), no gaps (inga hopp) in the domain

Name: The Extreme Value Theorem/Satsen om max/min, Weierstrass sats
Basic relationship: f continous [a, b] -> x, x assumes a local maximum or minimum value

f(x)=(sin^2(x)-tan(x))/(x^2+sqrt(x)+1)
Continous in [0, 1] -> both max and min value
(0, 1) -> no conclusion since open interval
[0,2] function not defined in full interval since tan(x) undefined x=\pi/2.

Name: The Intermediate Value Theorem/Satsen om mellanliggande värde
Basic relationship: f continous [a, b], f must take all the intermediate value between f(a) and f(b)
Check root for x^3+x+1=0 between [-1, 1] -> f(-1)=-1, f(1)=3, through 0 -> At least 1 or odd number of roots

Name: Asymptotes/Asymptoter
